1.directions:
Download a map of the Downtown Main Library. (PDF) A printed version of this map is available free at the Downtown Main Library.

The 9th St. entrance is closed. Please enter on Vine St. or Walnut St.

Accessible parking is available in a gated parking lot on the north side of 9th Street. Press the button on the intercom with your handicapped parking placard visible to access the lot. If needed, you may request assistance from Library staff to enter the building.

AV.name: Avondale Branch Library
AV.hoursNote: Service at the temporary Avondale Branch location ended Sept. 15 as work continues on a renovated library designed for the community's future.

DT.name: Delhi Township Branch Library
DT.hoursNote: The Delhi Township Branch closed Aug. 29 to prepare for the construction of the future branch. A temp space at 5125 Foley Road is now available. More information.
